correctness.rationale: Binet/Lucas formula decomposes fourth Fibonacci powers into distinct five modes 1,mu^{±1},mu^{±2} with characteristic polynomial (x−1)(x²+3x+1)(x²−7x+1), discriminant only divisible by 2,3,5. The monic integral recurrence reduces the gcd of infinitely many windows to its first five. Vandermonde over Z/p^e quadratic algebra for p>=7 separates modes; constant term forces p^e|k and t−1 invertibility converts s_k(t)=0 to t^k=1. Order h_p prime to p divides p±1; binomial lifting and constant-mode upper bound prove exact v_p formula. Direct independent k<=89 arithmetic checks corroborate; 2,3,5 excluded.
residual_risks: Local valuation statement omits p=2,3,5; unit discriminants fail there. Search not exhaustive for unindexed p-adic Lucas/Fibonacci literature.
